contents: the tempo lattice tables, transition and initial-tempo statistics, clock-noise and per-band event models, existence chains, level prior and the decoder settings of the frozen configuration
runtime_decision: Compiled into the DSP module as fixed values. The decoder reads them at run time and learns nothing; the lanes and the activation network only supply evidence.

fitted_values.values: tempo transitions and initial tempo distribution
fitted_values.fitted_on: Slakh2100-redux train split, 806 tracks (audible beat times)

fitted_values.values: clock noise and per-band event model
fitted_values.fitted_on: Slakh2100-redux train split (806 tracks) and Groove MIDI train fold (303 clips), the tracks with a stable audible-beat offset, with sources weighted equally

fitted_values.values: existence chains (per-band visibility of the beat events)
fitted_values.fitted_on: Slakh2100-redux train split (732 tracks, 288892 beats), Groove MIDI train fold (205 clips, 37500 beats), public-domain MusicNet recordings (155 recordings, 84902 beats) and public-domain Winterreise (24 recordings, 3834 beats), sources weighted equally
fitted_values.note: beat labels of the public-domain MusicNet recordings and of public-domain Winterreise are score beats placed by interpolation. The existence model read every public-domain MusicNet and public-domain Winterreise recording, including those that are also in the real-recording validation set used for selection.

fitted_values.values: level prior (how the perceived tempo relates to the annotated beat level)
fitted_values.fitted_on: outputs of the shipped activation network (tc_tcn_weights.h: the 64-channel network with IEEE binary16 weights, checkpoint sha256 ba5936764b614d1b89795472d0506213dd1ea497c26b04af6e8534536a4cca3d) on the training tracks of the six training sources (Slakh2100-redux 806, Groove MIDI 303, MusicNet public domain 123, GuitarSet 288, Candombe 33, BRID 79; folds 1 to 4 for the real recordings), sources weighted equally. Fold 0 of the real recordings and public-domain Winterreise were not read.
fitted_values.note: refitted for the shipped network with the unchanged recipe of the earlier prior (development tool scale/level_prior.py, not part of this repository); the network was trained on the same training tracks, so the fit is in-sample

fitted_values.values: activation class prior and level-model class prior

decoder_settings.derived_or_specified: the 4 s seed replay window (derived), the commit probability 0.95, the stand-in silence run of 24 quiet ticks (the quiet level, 50 dB below the 20 s decaying maximum with a -120 dBFS floor, is defined in decaying_max.h) and the 64-tick bank reach (specified)
